variants.headline: Still in view: building finished and handed over
variants.sub: The project {project} has been completed and handed over by {builder}.
variants.body:
The builder {builder} has finished and handed over {project}. Coverage of this story continues; the original event remains the starting point for the questions examined here.

Completion and handover are delivery milestones, while opening is an operating milestone. Our assessment favours {target} over a verdict that confuses an adverse interpretation with an established fact.
